app.title: WaveDudeNext 2D Wave Simulator
app.description: A 2D wave propagation simulator written in Rust and WebAssembly for educational purposes.
proposed_tests: Clone repository and run `cargo build` to ensure compilation passes.
Execute `cargo test` to run unit tests and validate simulation accuracy.
Run the provided `demo.html` in a browser and confirm wave patterns render.
Measure simulation performance by stepping through 10,000 timesteps and recording CPU time.
